title: INGCO CRHLI20208 20V Brushless Cordless Rotary Hammer | 22mm SDS-Plus | Concrete, Brick, Wood & Metal
description:
INGCO CRHLI20208 20V Brushless Cordless Rotary Hammer | 22mm SDS-Plus | Concrete, Brick, Wood & Metal
Built for power. Designed for precision.
The INGCO CRHLI20208 is a high-performance rotary hammer drill engineered for tough jobs. With a brushless motor and SDS-Plus chuck, it delivers powerful impact energy for drilling and chiseling through concrete, brick, wood, and metal — all with cordless freedom.

✅ Key Features
20V Cordless Power – Lithium-ion battery system for mobility and consistent performance.
Brushless Motor Technology – Longer lifespan, reduced maintenance, and higher efficiency.
22mm SDS-Plus Chuck – Quick bit changes and secure grip for heavy-duty applications.
3-Function Modes – Drill, hammer drill, and chisel for versatile use.
Ergonomic Design – Anti-vibration handle and balanced weight for comfortable extended use.
Depth Gauge & Side Handle – Enhanced control and precision for professional results.

What’s in the Box

1x Carry Case

Perfect For
Drilling into concrete, brick, and masonry
Wood and metal drilling
Light demolition and chiseling
Renovation and construction projects
Electrical and plumbing installations
